text.description_html:
Emtek BTB-76030, Lafayette Wrought Steel Back-to-Back Pulls

The Back-to-Back 8 Inch Lafayette Door Pull Set comes packaged with everything you'll need to install it including two handles and mounting hardware. This old world style door handle pair is made out of wrought steel and is available in flat black steel or satin steel finishes, both of which have a rough texture to add to the historic feel by imitating the texture of naturally weathered iron. The Lafayette Wrought Steel Back-to-Back Pulls will fit doors 1-3/8 inches to 2-1/4 inches thick.

Back-to-Back Mounting: Pulls bolt to each other through the door. Packaged with 2 door pulls (1 door pull for each side of a door).

Also Available: Lafayette Pull with Thru-Bolt Mounting

Specifications of the Emtek Lafayette Basket Pull Set:

  • Material: Wrought Steel
  • Total Length: 8-13/16"
  • Center to Center Length: 8"
  • Pull Handle Width: 1-5/16"
  • Total Projection: 2-1/2"
  • Base: 3/4"
  • Door Thickness: for doors 1-3/8" to 2-1/4" thick.
  • Includes installation hardware required for fiberglass, wood, and metal doors.

Sold as a Pair (2 Door Pulls) with Back-to-Back mounting.
